get_data: parse a JSON file of DFT and force field data into separate CO2 and H2O lists
binned_average: compute the average prediction error within each bin of DFT interaction energy values
get_Fig4a: generate a histogram comparing raw force field minus DFT error distributions for CO2 and H2O
get_Fig4b: create a binned average error bar plot with KDE density overlay for CO2 and H2O
phys_err: calculate the mean absolute error for physisorption data points between DFT and force field values
